<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Default">5e5a4b46833eb210979271d6feaad3f8</macroponent><name>Handle Login</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function checkStudentLogin() {

    var number = g_form.getValue('number');
    var password = g_form.getValue('password');

    // Check empty fields
    if (number === '' || password === '') {
        alert("Please enter Username and Password");
        return false;
    }

    var ga = new GlideAjax('CheckStudentLogin');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'checkLogin');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_number', number);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_password', password);

    ga.getXMLAnswer(function(response) {

        if (response === 'true') {
            alert("Login Successful");
            g_form.submit(); // continue login
        }
        else if (response === 'empty') {
            alert("Please fill all fields");
        }
        else {
            alert("Invalid Username or Password");
        }

    });

    return false;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>katakamlakshmi</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-03-07 10:14:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>8da3cc2483637a10979271d6feaad33f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Handle Login</sys_name><sys_package display_value="AlmaConnect" source="x_1909965_almaconn">3882be6183763210979271d6feaad3fc</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AlmaConnect">3882be6183763210979271d6feaad3fc</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_8da3cc2483637a10979271d6feaad33f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>katakamlakshmi</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-03-10 10:23:20</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
